name: Wizup
author: wizupapp

sections.description:
Wizup connects WooCommerce directly to an advanced automation system, enabling smart, automatic, and efficient communication with your customers throughout the entire order lifecycle.

With Wizup, you can send automatic messages for new orders, status changes, cancellations, and shipments, as well as bring back customers who haven’t completed their purchase using abandoned cart reminders.

The plugin is suitable for stores that want to improve service, increase conversions, and manage modern communication with customers – without manual work and without complicated plugins.

Main Features:
* Send automatic messages for new orders
* Update customers on order status changes (processing, shipped, cancelled, etc.)
* Recover abandoned carts using automatic reminders
* Add support buttons to product pages
* Manage customized message templates
* Full integration with WooCommerce order lifecycles
* Quick and simple connection without technical knowledge

Third Party Service

The plugin uses a third-party service to send messages and manage automations.

Third-Party Service: Wizup API
Website: https://wizup.app

The service is used for sending messages, managing templates, automations, and tracking activity.

  • Terms of Use: https://wizup.app/terms-of-use
  • Privacy Policy: https://wizup.app/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugin directory or upload it manually.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Log in to your Wizup account or create a new account on the Wizup website.
  4. Configure connection details and system messages.
  5. Start sending automatic messages to your customers.
sections.faq:
Is a Wizup account required to use the plugin?

Yes. The plugin operates using the Wizup system and requires an active account to send messages.

Can I edit the message text?

Yes. You can configure customized message templates for each event type.

Which order statuses are supported?

The plugin supports all common WooCommerce statuses, including new order, processing, shipped, completed, and cancelled.

Does the plugin support abandoned cart recovery?

Yes. Wizup allows sending automatic reminders to customers who did not complete their purchase.

Is technical knowledge or development required?

No. Setup and configuration are simple and suitable even for users without technical knowledge.
